title: PipelineProposal
description: A proposed pipeline (roots[] + a tree of transform steps + zero-or-more Outputs) produced by an agent (or a fixture). Carries NO ids — nothing is created until the proposal is applied via POST /api/pipelines/apply-proposal. HEL-907 task 1.1: retargeted from the old single output DataType contract (outputDataTypeName) onto Outputs -- `steps`/`outputs` reuse POST /api/pipelines' own single-call transactional shapes (CreatePipelineTransactionalStepRequest/CreatePipelineTransactionalOutputRequest, HEL-906) verbatim, so a step's `clientId` and an output's `nodeStepClientId` can address tree shape and per-node Output placement before anything has a real persisted id. HEL-914: the old singular `source` is REPLACED outright by a non-empty `roots` array (design.md D2) -- there is no accepted alias; a payload carrying `source` is rejected, not tolerated. Each root is a `PipelineProposalSource` plus an optional `clientId` a parentless step's `rootClientId` binds to (design.md R13); a parentless step on a multi-root proposal with no `rootClientId` is a named 400, never a silent default to roots[0].

roots.description: Ordered list of proposed roots -- request-address position i is named `roots[i]` in validation errors (design.md D5, reusing PipelineService.rootAddress). Each root's optional `clientId` is what a parentless step's `rootClientId` binds to.

steps.description: Ordered list of transform steps -- mirrors the add_pipeline_step MCP tool's {type, config} contract and POST /api/pipelines/:id/steps, plus clientId/parentStepId for expressing branching tree shape in one call (design.md decision 2).

outputs.description: Optional -- a pipeline proposal may create zero Outputs, to be added later via add_output. Each Output's nodeStepClientId resolves against steps[].clientId in this same proposal; absent means the pipeline's raw source.

PipelineProposalSource.description: Either a reference to an existing data source (sourceId) or an inline new-source spec (type/name/config). Both forms are representable at once — this schema does not enforce mutual exclusivity; resolving which branch wins when both are present is an apply-time (HEL-342) concern.

sourceId.description: Existing-source branch — id of a caller-owned DataSource to reuse as-is.

type.description: Inline-source branch — the new source's kind. Selects which shape `config` must conform to. A deliberate narrowing of the full connector registry (text/pdf/image excluded) per this ticket's scope.

name.description: Inline-source branch — the new source's display name.

config.description: Inline-source branch — the per-type config payload selected by `type`: csv -> {path}; rest_api -> {url, method?, auth?, headers?}; sql -> {dialect, host, port, database, user, password, query}; static -> {columns, rows}. A single shared property regardless of `type`, matching CreatePipelineStepRequest's config and DataSourceResponse's per-subtype config convention.

clientId.description: HEL-914: request-scoped id a parentless step's `rootClientId` binds to when the proposal has more than one root. Not persisted.
